name: Comic Con India (Pune)
blurb: Pune leg of Comic Con India's national pop-culture tour, run with ReedPop, with comics-industry and pop-culture guests.
notes: No live 2026-27 event page on comicconindia.com as of this check (the 'all-cities-main-page/pune-comic-con' URL now 404s and its cached copy was footed 'Comic Con India 2025'). Outlook India/respawn reported an official Comic Con India announcement of a Pune edition for Mar 21-22, 2026 at Yash Lawns, Bibvewadi, presented by Maruti Suzuki Arena and Crunchyroll -- recorded here as the last edition since it is before this check date (2026-10-05); no 2027 Pune date has been announced yet.
